precondition: Forward destination word addresses are unique and disjoint from all source word addresses, as required by glue_plan.py:209-226. Source maps may overlap, repeat or broadcast; the general reverse accumulates in reverse op order and ascending element order in binary64 and rounds each distinct source address once.

launch_abi.l4_speed: ad/window-L4-speed: reverse entries ['l4_check', 'l4_direct', 'l4_serial'] replace the reference single reverse entry; tangent unchanged; see phys/l4speed/README.md

affine_reason: Twelve fixed-index copies of 32-bit words: the identity map on each copied element.
why: The fused twelve-row 64-bit strided copy specialization is outside the frozen ad-gen operation set; the general copy-plan derivative and binder admission are not implemented here.

general_transpose.order: reverse operation order, then ascending logical element
general_transpose.accumulation: binary64 per distinct physical source address, rounded once
general_transpose.workspace: 2 hash buckets per logical copy element; fixed zero initialization
